name: Codefresh
description: Codefresh is a modern DevOps platform that streamlines software development and delivery. It offers powerful CI/CD tools to help developers build, test, and deploy applications efficiently, simplifying complex workflows for teams aiming to enhance their DevOps practices.

events.d: Create a new Codefresh team, add specified users, and apply optional tags.
Add an annotation to a Codefresh entity (pipeline, build, or deployment).
Retrieve a paginated list of workflow builds, optionally filtered by status, pipeline, git provider/repo, trigger reason, and date range.
Create a new Codefresh execution context with a name, optional description, and tags.
Triggers when a new project is created in scheduled time.
Create a new Codefresh agent and optionally attach runtime environments. Returns the created agent details and access token.
